prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Pet Retention Hint: Adds a hint under sign-in options explicitly explaining that signing in restores previous desktop pet data and prevents account resets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign_in hints have a high historical win rate (3 out of 6).)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Milestones Wait Display: Displays a milestone progress checklist on the waiting screen showing rendering progress from asset assembly to desktop launch. (why: The home step has a long mean duration of 2336 seconds and finish drop-off is 64.8%, while wait_info changes have a 2 out of 3 win rate.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Anchor Setup Screen: Adds a new onboarding screen before home_intro detailing desktop anchoring and quick tray controls for the pet. (why: 3 support messages cited confusion on controlling or hiding the pet post-onboarding, and 3 cited desktop launch visibility issues.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Stalling Safety Notice Hint: Displays a lightweight status hint on the sign-in screen confirming connection security and instant sign-in processing. (why: Support logged emails regarding sign-in screen stalling or non-appearance, and sign_in hints consistently test well.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Background Notification Wait Alert: Enables a background desktop alert option on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes. (why: Home wait time averages 2336 seconds; wait_info improvements reduce drop-off during long background rendering.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Image Validation Sub-Flow: Inserts a photo validation screen immediately after photo upload to verify clarity and rendering compatibility before generation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failures or poor rendering results during adoption.)
6: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Photo-Upload Sign-In Sequence Reorder: Reorders the onboarding sequence to place sign-in right after photo upload, securing pet creation progress before certificate completion. (why: Moving sign-in after pet customization protects custom work while maintaining sign_in conversion strength.)
7: [finish, notification] Finish Step Companion Active Desktop Notification Switch: Adds an active desktop notification setting toggle on the home_intro screen to confirm pet launch status. (why: 3 support emails reported desktop pet visual display failures upon completing onboarding.)
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Companion Seal Incentive: Adds an official adoption seal badge component to the adoption certificate screen celebrating pet ownership. (why: Adoption step conversion is only 66.0%; adding visual reward incentives boosts completion motivation.)
